item.title: Happy Factory
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Grand Cru classe
  • 発売日: 2011-06-24
  • スコア: 6.29/10 (12 人評価)
  • 日本語名: はっぴぃふぁくとりー
  • 英語名: Happy Factory

あらすじ

Nanahouka Gakuen was built as a test facility to solve problems with the escalator system that is a commonplace. Yuu’s normal school life turns upside down when the school board chairman declares that there isn’t enough happiness in the school and forms the Happy Factory Club (HFC). He is forced into the club so that he can enjoy a happy adolescence.

item.title: Shooting My Star☆ ~Onii-chan, Kakugo Shitete yo ne♪~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Grand Cru classe
  • 発売日: 2011-03-31
  • スコア: 6.69/10 (16 人評価)
  • 日本語名: しゅ～てぃんぐ妹スター☆ ～お兄ちゃん、覚悟しててよね♪～
  • 英語名: Shooting My Star☆ Onii-chan, Kakugo Shitete yo ne♪

あらすじ

On a day when Subaru was striving toward his dreams, his parents suddenly announced they were going on a two-week overseas trip to celebrate their silver wedding anniversary. The news left Subaru and his younger sisters, Haruka and Towa, stunned.

Worried about protecting his twin sisters during their parents’ absence, Subaru tried to stay vigilant. But the two little devils had their own plans brewing…
